I will keep cotton as my main crop because that is the system I know best, it fits my land and irrigation conditions in Quzhou County, and after 20 years of farming I trust it more than making a big shift. I have 379.9 mu and a four-person household, so I need a plan I can actually manage through the whole season without spreading labor too thin. I will put most of the land into cotton and keep a smaller but still meaningful area in maize so I have some balance in income and harvest timing. For seed, I will use improved cotton seed and hybrid maize seed because I want stronger stand establishment and more stable yield. I will use plough tillage before planting because I want a clean seedbed and better rooting at the start of the season. Since I have well irrigation, I will rely on several timely irrigations instead of gambling on rainfall. I will feed cotton more heavily and protect it more often because it stays longer in the field and is more vulnerable to pests; maize will get a simpler program with moderate fertilizer, fewer sprays, and fewer irrigations. My aim is not the most aggressive plan on paper, but a steady plan I believe I can carry through from planting to harvest on this farm.
